cases.name: exact
cases.description: A catalog id as-is resolves exactly.

cases.name: bare-name
cases.description: A bare model name (what SDK calls carry) resolves to the single provider-prefixed catalog id via the tail rule.

cases.name: normalized-case
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 3: case/separator differences resolve through the cachelint norm rule when unambiguous.

cases.name: slash-tail
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 3: with a provider prefix that matches nothing, the text after the last '/' is tried under the same rule.

cases.name: dotted-separators
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 3: dots normalize to dashes (claude-sonnet-4.6 -> claude-sonnet-4-6).

cases.name: alias-dated-anthropic
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 4a: an Anthropic dated API id resolves through the SDK's native-id -> OpenRouter slug table when that slug is in the catalog.

cases.name: alias-dated-anthropic-prefixed
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 4: the fallback works on the text after the last '/', so a provider-prefixed dated id resolves too.

cases.name: alias-dated-vertex
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 4b: a Vertex-style '@YYYYMMDD' date suffix is dropped and the tail rule retried (dash-vs-dot via norm).

cases.name: alias-latest-table
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 4a: an xAI '-latest' alias resolves through the slug table.

cases.name: alias-latest-suffix
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 4b: a '-latest' suffix is dropped and the tail rule retried (grok-4-1-fast -> x-ai/grok-4.1-fast).

cases.name: alias-table-undated
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 4a: a table id with no strippable suffix (mistral-medium-2508) still maps to its catalog slug.

cases.name: alias-target-not-in-catalog
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 4: the table target (mistralai/mistral-large) is not in this catalog and stripping finds no single model — never guessed to a sibling (mistral-large-2512).

cases.name: alias-openai-dashed-date-unresolved
cases.description: SPEC §2.1 step 4b: only a compact YYYYMMDD date is stripped; an OpenAI dashed snapshot date is left alone and stays unresolved.

cases.name: alias-unknown-dated-unresolved
cases.description: SPEC §2.1: stripping a date from an unknown model still finds nothing — it resolves to nothing, not to a nearby model.

cases.name: alias-unknown-latest-unresolved
cases.description: SPEC §2.1: stripping '-latest' from an unknown model still finds nothing.

cases.name: earlier-step-wins
cases.description: SPEC §2.1: the fallback is consulted only when steps 1-3 find nothing — an undated id that matches via the tail rule keeps method 'normalized'.

cases.name: unresolved
cases.description: SPEC §2.1: no fuzzy matching — an unknown model resolves to nothing.

cases.name: empty
cases.description: SPEC §2.1: an absent/empty model resolves to nothing.
